body: HIS VACUUM-FLOAT MAIN LINE HAS ITS FIRST MAP POINT, at 19:47, ten hours inside its 06:00 time. Una admitted the first estimates card (arithmetic and source tags only; nothing certified). WHAT IT SAYS: all three hull families float at 500 m; none yet survives the crush. Crush safety factor and the stiffness each would need: thin aluminium shell 0.0009 (about 1156x stiffer), aluminium sandwich 0.12 (about 8x, the nearest; a thicker core reaches 0.20 but stops floating), frame with film 0.033 (about 30x). Those are buckling-only figures: the card omits metal strength, so they are optimistic. NEXT, funded 19:5x: a second card adds strength limits and one float-margin alternative per family, owner by 10-20 09:00, Una by noon. The certified reference route stays parked: this card names nothing it would firm up. Charged 995 of 3600 s; the rest retired.
